sentences.en: We analyze the numbers every Monday.
She analyzes customer feedback before we change the product.
I analyze my spending at the end of each month.
They analyze traffic on the site after big sales.
The coach analyzes each match on video.
He analyzes risks before we sign the contract.
Do you analyze the logs when the app crashes?
Why did you analyze that email for so long?
How often does your team analyze sales by region?
Don't analyze every text message like it's a court case.
Please analyze this chart and tell me what stands out.
Let's not analyze the joke to death.
I analyzed the problem last night and found a simple fix.
She analyzed the sample in the lab yesterday.
We analyzed three options and picked the cheapest one.
He analyzed the error report after the update failed.
They analyzed the water when people complained about the taste.
I didn't analyze the fine print, and I regretted it.
The doctor analyzed my results and called me the same day.
She never analyzed her habits until her sleep got worse.
I used to analyze every purchase, but now I set a simple budget.
We used to analyze the same report twice because the data was messy.
He used to analyze games alone before he joined a fan group.
When I was in school, I analyzed practice tests until I saw the pattern.
I will analyze the proposal tomorrow morning.
We are going to analyze user drop-off on the signup page.
She will analyze the blood work when the lab sends it.
They will analyze the defense before the next match.
I would analyze it more if I had an extra hour.
He would analyze every detail, but the deadline is tonight.
We would analyze the market first if we had cleaner data.
I have analyzed this file twice and I still see the same issue.
She has analyzed enough surveys to spot the pattern fast.
We haven't analyzed last week's numbers yet.
He has never analyzed a budget this tight before.
I need to analyze the bill before I pay it.
She wants to analyze the route before we book flights.
They forgot to analyze the backup before they deleted the folder.
Try to analyze what went wrong without blaming people.
Remember to analyze costs before you expand the team.
If you analyze the steps, the process is not that hard.
When the test fails, analyze the message at the bottom first.
Although the chart looks fine, we should analyze the raw data.
Because the price jumped, I analyzed my subscriptions again.
Before you reply, analyze whether this fight is even worth it.
After we analyze the interview notes, we will pick a candidate.
I analyze my calendar on Sunday because the week fills up fast.
She analyzes recipes when she wants to cut sugar, not flavor.
We analyze grocery prices across two stores near our apartment.
He analyzes his lifts after the gym to track progress.
The team analyzes set pieces when they lose a close game.
I analyzed the train times, but the delay still ruined the plan.
She analyzed the hotel reviews before she booked the room.
We analyzed the noise map and chose a quieter street.
He analyzed the repair quote because it seemed high.
They analyzed the Wi-Fi signal and moved the router.
I will analyze my habits this month if I keep the same routine.
You should analyze your bank fees at least once a year.
Don't analyze your friend's tone if you already trust them.
Does the tool analyze errors automatically, or do we tag them?
Who will analyze the security report from the vendor?
I can't analyze this PDF on my phone; the screen is too small.
We don't analyze weekend traffic the same way we analyze weekdays.
She won't analyze the data until she has the full export.
If we analyze the timeline, the delay started after the merge.
When you analyze your mood, note sleep and caffeine too.
He loves football, but he does not analyze his friends' private messages.
Before dinner, analyze what you already have in the fridge.
After lunch, we analyze the morning blockers in a short stand-up.
I analyzed the meeting notes, but I still missed one action item.
She has analyzed enough injury reports to know when to rest.
We have analyzed similar cases, and the outcome is usually the same.
He had analyzed the roster before he made the trade in fantasy football.
I was analyzing the map when my phone died.
They were analyzing the sample when the alarm went off.
I want to analyze the offer, but I need the full terms in writing.
She needs to analyze her schedule before she says yes to another trip.
We should analyze whether the free plan is enough for next year.
He tries not to analyze every awkward pause on a first date.
The nurse said the lab will analyze the test by tomorrow.
I analyzed the bus route, but I still missed my stop.
If you don't analyze the risk, you can't price it honestly.
When the app freezes, analyze memory use before you blame the network.
Although the headline scared people, the report analyzes the trend calmly.
Because we analyzed last quarter, this quarter feels easier.
After you analyze the feedback, share the top three themes.
Before you invest, analyze what happens if the market drops.
We analyzed the plan, but we still chose the safer option.
She analyzes her runs with a simple app and a weekly goal.
I will analyze the contract with a lawyer if the numbers look odd.
They have not analyzed the new rule change yet.
Have you analyzed the difference between the two insurance plans?
Let's analyze the steps now so we don't repeat the same mistake.
Please don't analyze my tone in a group chat.
I analyze the weather app before I plan a long bike ride.
He analyzed the opponent's last three games before the derby.
We are analyzing the budget line by line this afternoon.
She would analyze the data faster if the columns had clearer names.
If you love the hobby, you don't have to analyze every minute of it.
Tomorrow I will analyze the notes from the client call and send a summary.
